## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Security and compatibility impact

- Does this touch tokens, HTTP/WebSocket transport, provider ownership,
  dispatch/replay behavior, state files, service lifecycle, or package contents?
- Which operating systems and T3 Code/Hermes Agent versions were tested?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] Logs and fixtures contain no tokens, prompts, usernames, private paths, or
      private project names.
- [ ] Documentation and uninstall/rollback instructions were updated when needed.

## Evidence

List exact commands and concise results. Attach only redacted output.
